## About
Camilo Automotive Garage is a neighborhood repair shop in Hialeah Gardens. We handle steering and suspension, brakes, tires, maintenance, and engine diagnostics and repairs, on all makes and models.
We try to keep it simple: high quality parts, fair prices, and a clear explanation of what your car actually needs. A reviewer said we showed them what had to be fixed and what could wait, and that is how we like to work.
Drivers have rated us 4.8 from 128 Google reviews. A recent customer gave a thank you to David and Aura by name. Give us a call to set up an appointment.

## Services
- Steering and suspension: Alignment, shocks and struts, and rack and pinion work.
- Maintenance and inspections: Oil changes, computer-aided engine diagnostics and inspections to keep your car running right.
- Air-conditioning service: When the air-conditioning quits on you, bring it in and we will take a look.
- Brake services: Brake work for all makes and models.
- Engine diagnostics and repairs: We track down what is wrong and fix it, from minor to major problems.
- Tire services: Tire rotation, repair, mounting, wheel balance and tire pressure checks.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free repair quotes?
A: Yes. Tell us what is going on with your car and we will give you a free quote on the repair.

Q: What kinds of cars do you work on?
A: We work on all makes and models.

Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: Give the shop a call to set up a time that works for you.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, from 8 AM to 3 PM. We are closed on Sunday.
